title: Neural Network Optimization Reimagined: Decoupled Techniques for Scratch and Fine-Tuning (DualOpt)
mechanism: For fine-tuning, a per-step weight rollback toward upstream weights inside the optimizer, with rollback strength adapted per layer; evaluated on classification, detection, semantic and instance segmentation.
adaptation: Encoder-only rollback with layer3/4 rolled back hardest; second regulariser if SPD wins.
evidence: State of the art across classification, detection, semantic and instance segmentation (abstract; numbers not retrieved).
min_experiment: Arm DualOpt vs SPD vs PF, seeds 5-9. Kill if not above PF on any co-primary.
prior_overlap: Partial via PF, same as SPD.
